description: Detection-as-Code corpus: Sigma, correlation, and YARA rules with ATT&CK mapping, false-positive documentation, lifecycle tracking, SIEM translation notes, and Architecture Decision Records.
counts_note: All counts are floors, not exact totals. The corpus is actively expanding. Run the discovery commands in README.md for live counts.
